newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Aboitiz spins off power operations.
newsitem.headline: Aboitiz spins off power operations.

text.p: Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc said on Wednesday it would consolidate its energy-related operations and spin them off into a single 100-percent owned subsidiary.

The company told the Philippine Stock Exchange that the move would allow the subsidiary, Aboitiz Power Corp, to focus on the power sector which would be the main contributor to the company's future growth.
Aboitiz operates eight power companies, mostly in southern Philippines, whose services include power generation and distribution.
They contributed 33 percent of the company's net income in the first quarter.
Aside from power, Aboitiz is also engaged in transportation and banking.
